formats: Designed for flexibility and performance, this all-in-one speakerphone features advanced AEC, AGC and ANS for crystal-clear audio in remote conferences. With support for USB and Bluetooth connectivity, it adapts seamlessly to various setups—from huddle rooms to large meeting spaces. Equipped with 4 omnidirectional mic arrays and a powerful full-range speaker, it offers plug-and-play convenience and broad compatibility with major operating systems and conferencing platforms. Cascading up to 9 same speakerphones, it ensures reliable coverage and high-quality audio in any collaboration environment.

Equipped with 4 omnidirectional digital microphone arrays for 360° voice pickup and a built-in 3W full-range speaker, delivering clear, balanced audio for both local playback and remote communication.

Engineered for exceptional sound clarity, HALO 80 delivers rich, natural-sounding audio through a finely tuned speaker and advanced signal processing. Whether it's a one-on-one call or a hybrid group meeting, voices come through with fullness and precision, minimizing listener fatigue and improving communication flow.

recommendedWhen: Camera, microphone, speakerphone, USB peripheral or conferencing workflows are part of the requirement.

salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the room needs to support video meetings, shared audio, cameras, microphones or BYOM/BYOD collaboration.

salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Huddle rooms, boardrooms, classrooms and hybrid meeting spaces.

consultant.value: Helps separate a technically possible product choice from the strongest design choice for the application, budget, risk and future expansion.
